Name: Potions Maker
Author: cullendoran
Description:
Buff up your gameplay with potions for every possible need! From skill stat boosts to healing, this mod has it all!
I recommend that you download the "Lookup Anything" mod to help with in-game recipes, and the "UIInfoSuite2" mod for showing current player buffs.

*NOTE: This mod is heavily WIP and will have more items over time as I update it*
[color=#00ff00][size=6]Current Content: 
[/size][/color] ﻿Animals: Ruby Chicken, Emerald Chicken
﻿Items: Weak Potion Flask, Coated Potion Flask, Ruby Egg, Emerald Egg, Monster Mash, Gem Monster Mash, Monster Wax
﻿Potions: Weak Skill Potions (Increases by 1 the stat depending on the potion you use), Weak Luck Potion, Weak Magnet Potion, Weak Rainbow Potion & ﻿it's ﻿parts, Coated variants to all Weak Potions

This mod is heavily inspired by the 'Slime livestock and potion brewing" mod

Downloads.Description: Added Emerald Chicken and gave the emerald egg a use for gem monster mash, and added the new LuckE Basics mod that's now used as a base for all my mods as a requirement.
